name: Misono Hana
source:
She is rumored to be the most popular and cutest girl in the school, and is particularly known for the striking contrast between her innocent appearance and her voluptuous figure.

She is said to have a bright, cheerful personality and is kind to everyone—truly the perfect beauty… or so they say.

However, she is actually somewhat introverted and has intentionally adjusted her personality and appearance so that people can easily tell her apart from her twin sister, Mana.

Due to certain circumstances, she decided to take the entrance exam for Koiwaga Academy, a co-ed school, instead of attending the all-girls school she was supposed to enter through the school’s automatic promotion system.

After discovering that Ryousuke, for some reason, could tell her and Manai apart, she began actively seeking him out as the only person she could truly open up to.

She has a slightly masochistic side; the rougher he is with her, the more she feels desired, and the happier she becomes.

[From the [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/futakoi/character.html]official website[/url]]
